# Pre-binning Kraken summary

```{r}
load_processed_data(
  "./data/NG_probe/curated/pre_binning_kraken_data.RDS",
  "pre_binning_kraken_summary"
)

kraken_table <- pre_binning_kraken_summary %>%
  mutate(
    pool_level = factor(
      as.character(pool_level),
      levels = c("High", "Medium", "Low")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(pool_level, unclassified_percent) %>%
  transmute(
    Isolate = sample,
    Pool = as.character(pool_level),
    `Total read pairs` = total_reads,
    `Unclassified, n (%)` = sprintf(
      "%s (%.2f%%)",
      scales::comma(unclassified_reads),
      unclassified_percent
    ),
    `Bacteria, n (%)` = sprintf(
      "%s (%.2f%%)",
      scales::comma(bacteria_reads),
      bacteria_percent
    ),
    `Neisseria, n (%)` = sprintf(
      "%s (%.2f%%)",
      scales::comma(neisseria_reads),
      neisseria_percent
    ),
    `N. gonorrhoeae, n (%)` = sprintf(
      "%s (%.2f%%)",
      scales::comma(ng_reads),
      ng_percent
    ),
    `Bacteria identified as Neisseria (%)` = sprintf(
      "%.2f",
      bacteria_as_neisseria_percent
    ),
    `Neisseria identified as N. gonorrhoeae (%)` = sprintf(
      "%.2f",
      neisseria_as_ng_percent
    )
  )

if (nrow(kraken_table) != 12 || anyDuplicated(kraken_table$Isolate)) {
  stop("Expected one Kraken summary row for each of the 12 pilot isolates")
}

readr::write_csv(kraken_table, paste0(table_prefix, ".csv"))
kraken_table
```
